findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?via=mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_weather_roast · Private data: record_card_event · Public sink: weather_word_puzzle_guess, weather_word_puzzle_give_up, submit_guess.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_weather_roast · Private data: record_card_event · Public sink: weather_word_puzzle_guess, weather_word_puzzle_give_up, submit_guess

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
